sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Hiking is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hello, my friend! Do you enjoy hiking? I do not, which is why I need your help. In the northwestern part of the Priozersk forest, scavengers are preventing my men from delivering humanitarian supplies. The area must be cleared. Got it?"

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - Must reach Loyalty Level 1 with Peacekeeper to obtain this quest.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 10 Scavs at USEC camp, Scav camp, sawmill, or abandoned village on Woods

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +3,000 EXP
- Peacekeeper Rep +0.1
- 550 Dollars
  - 578 Dollars with Intelligence center Level 1
  - 633 Dollars with Intelligence center Level 2
- 3× CPU fan
- Unlocks purchase of Galvion Caiman Hybrid helmet (Grey) at Peacekeeper LL2
"You did it! Great! Here is your reward."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text: In this quest you have to kill 10 Scavs at, and around the 4 mentioned locations on Woods.
